description: Four stereo channels summed to one stereo pair, each with a level and a pan

params.text: Sets that channel's level, silent at the bottom and unity at the top
Pans that channel by turning the far side down and leaving the near side at full level, so both sides are at full level at centre

inputs.text: The left side of that channel, and the whole of it when the channel's R jack is empty
The right side of that channel; with nothing patched it takes whatever is in the L jack beside it

outputs.text: The four channels' left sides summed
The four channels' right sides summed

notes: There is no output limiter: four channels at unity add up, and the sum can leave the module well above 10V.
